spec.title: Publish VSCode Extension to GitHub Packages
spec.context: Users cannot easily install the Claude Kanban VSCode extension. Currently they must manually download and install the .vsix file. This task enables single-command installation via npx @mattfletcher94/claudeban-vscode, matching the existing pattern for the kanban CLI package.

in-scope.item: Configure package.json for GitHub Packages publishing
Add vscode:publish script to root package.json
ANSI-colored CLI output following existing patterns

requirements.requirement: The installer shall be invocable via npx @mattfletcher94/claudeban-vscode
The installer shall locate the bundled .vsix file relative to its own location
The installer shall run code --install-extension with the .vsix path
The installer shall display ANSI-colored output using cyan, green, yellow, red color scheme
The installer shall support --help flag showing usage information
The installer shall support --version flag showing the extension version from package.json
The installer shall display next steps after successful installation
The installer shall let code CLI errors propagate naturally to the user

files.file: Add bin entry, publishConfig, repository, files array

patterns.pattern: Reference: apps/kanban/bin/install.cjs:1-279 - Shebang with #!/usr/bin/env node - ANSI color constants object - Helper functions: log, logStep, logSuccess, logWarning, logError - parseArgs function for CLI flags - showHelp and showVersion functions - async main() with try/catch
Reference: apps/kanban/package.json:35-38 - registry: https://npm.pkg.github.com - access: restricted

product.finding: Existing npx distribution pattern for @mattfletcher94/claudeban. Users configure ~/.npmrc with GitHub PAT, then run npx command.

engineering.finding: Build pipeline uses prepublishOnly hook. Package exposes CLI via bin field. Installer copies files and shows colored output.

codebase.finding: apps/vscode/package.json already has build and package scripts

pitfalls.finding: VSCode code command may not be in PATH on some systems. Mitigation: Let the error from child_process propagate naturally - user will see the actual error message which is more helpful than a custom check.
Installer package.json version is fixed (does not change). --version flag reads actual extension version from apps/vscode/package.json which is embedded at build time. Single source of truth.

constraints.constraint: Must use CommonJS (.cjs) for installer to match existing pattern and Node compatibility
Package version in installer package.json is fixed - --version reads from extension package.json
Requires user to have ~/.npmrc configured with GitHub Packages registry and PAT

external.dependency: Node.js child_process (built-in) - for running code CLI
VSCode code CLI - must be in user's PATH

internal.dependency: apps/vscode build process must produce .vsix file

risk.mitigation: Let error propagate with helpful message

risks.risk: code CLI not in PATH - user sees clear error from the system
